get.description: Returns the single best match for the text, administrative units resolved. Served from a short-lived cache when the same text was asked recently, from a stored address whose text matches exactly (case/diacritics/punctuation aside) when one was resolved before, otherwise from the configured map provider — `resolvedBy` reports which. When `data` is null, `reason` separates text nothing matches (NO_RESULT) from a provider that could not be reached (PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, worth retrying). A miss still spends a paid lookup, so call the provider directly from the client for type-ahead suggestions. Set `forceProvider` only after a person has rejected the answer they were given: it bypasses everything already known and spends a paid provider lookup every time.
